messages:
Maya (Finance): Heads up: invoice #8247 (ACME Health) failed on renewal — card decline from acquirer with odd AVS/3DS flags. Customer emailed asking for help.
Sam (Payments): Can you paste the gateway decline?
Maya (Finance): gateway: status=declined; code=92; reason=issuer_referred; cvv=match; avs=partial; 3ds_status=challenge_required
Eli (Support): They said they updated card last week and tried retry via UI; same outcome.
Sam (Payments): Code 92 = non-automatable, typically needs issuer intervention. Also gateway shows 3DS challenge not completed — possibly mobile flow blocked.
payments-bot: webhook received: payment_intent.8247 failed, decline_code=92 at 2026-03-15T14:02:13Z
Nora (Accounting): Invoice is $18,200. Options: one-time grace + retry, manual collect via wire, or temporary account credit. Which do we prefer?
Maya (Finance): Prefer wire to avoid refund/credit churn. Pause auto-retry while customer wires. Any wire limits/KYC?
Nora (Accounting): Wires up to $50k ok. I'll prepare instructions.
Sam (Payments): Also offer customer the option to re-add the card on desktop to complete 3DS and we'll attempt one immediate charge only.
Eli (Support): Messaging customer now: "We can accept a wire (reply 'WIRE' for instructions) or try re-adding your card on desktop to complete 3DS. If no response in 48h we'll pause the subscription to avoid repeated failures."
payments-bot: follow-up reminder set for invoice 8247 in 48h
Eli (Support): Customer replied: "WIRE". Forwarding to finance. :thumbsup: 
Nora (Accounting): Sent wire instructions and asked for bank confirmation. Email subject: 'Redwood Inference - Wire instructions for invoice 8247'. Included ref: invoice 8247 - ACME Health.
Sam (Payments): Once proof of transfer received I'll mark invoice paid and cancel retries. Add internal note to avoid automatic refund flow.
Maya (Finance): Action items: (1) block auto-retries for this invoice, (2) add KB note about desktop 3DS for customers, (3) triage step for decline_code=92 to check acquirer routing. Closing loop after payment clears.
Eli (Support): Noted. Will update when treasury confirms. :white_check_mark:
